values: 一名优雅的美食家，能在战斗时从容地处理敌人。
An elegant gourmet and deadly Mage who effortlessly slices through enemies in battle.
Ladies and gentlemen, it's time to dine.
主菜上桌，到了品鉴的时刻。
Time for a little taste test.
食材非常新鲜，多谢款待。
欢迎光临，我是主厨法蒂玛，今晚想吃点什么？
Plating is an art form in itself.
Mmm. Full-bodied with a lingering finish.
只有刀锋够快，猎物才不会感觉到痛苦。
With a blade sharp enough, the prey feels no pain.
这里的热闹程度快比得上丝绒陷阱了
This place is nearly as lively as Silken Snare.
这里的食物和客人，都很可口呢
The food here, and the guests, are quite... appetizing.
口味尚可，可惜餐具不够高级
The flavor is passable, but the tableware lacks true refinement.
法蒂玛总能“猜”到客人的心思。很多时候熟客刚落座，甚至刚在路上产生“今天想吃点什么”的念头，最契合他们心意的料理就已经端上了餐桌。
Voracia has an uncanny knack for reading her customers' minds. Many of her regulars are served exactly what they are craving the moment they take their seats.
法蒂玛对食材的挑选近乎苛刻，她能仅凭肉眼就判断出食材的新鲜程度。
Voracia is fastidious about ingredients. One glance, and she knows exactly how fresh they are.
法蒂玛的手臂异常灵活。在最繁忙的高峰期，她能够同时处理八口不同的锅、进行八道不同菜品的摆盘，不出任何差错。
Voracia's arms are astonishingly dexterous. At the busiest times of day, she can prepare and plate eight different dishes at once, all with flawless precision.
无论处理多么血腥的生肉，法蒂玛的仪态始终优雅从容，她的裙子也总是纤尘不染。
Even when handling the goriest tasks, Voracia carries herself with grace. Her dress somehow always remains spotless.
据跟随她多年的老员工私下回忆，主厨的外貌几乎没有任何变化。十年前她是什么样，现在依然如此，连一丝细纹都未曾增加。
According to her longtime employees, Voracia has hardly aged. She looks exactly like she did ten years ago, without so much as a single new wrinkle.
法蒂玛拥有惊人的味蕾。任何复杂的菜肴，只要被她品尝过一次，她就能完美复刻，甚至加以改良，做得比原版更好。
Voracia's exceptional palate allows her to recreate any dish she has tasted, no matter how complex it is. She can even refine the recipe and make the dish better than the original.
法蒂玛在各地都享有盛誉，此次是被嘉德侯爵特别邀请来的，所以她在赛凡纳经营的时间并不会很长。因此她的餐厅也一座难求。
Voracia is a renowned chef throughout Esperia. At Marquis Gervais' invitation, she has opened a pop-up restaurant in Savannah, and reservations are in exceptionally high demand.
尽管法蒂玛精通各种烹饪，但她个人的专属加餐永远是最顶级的生食。她享受那种最原始、最未经雕琢的口感。
Though Voracia has mastered every style of cooking, she personally prefers raw dishes made from the finest ingredients. She relishes flavors in their purest, most unrefined form.
曾有某个年轻的贵族称呼法蒂玛为“主厨阿姨”，她回以极其温柔优雅的微笑。只是稍后不小心在这桌客人的餐品中，混入了一种苦得让人灵魂出窍的蛮血香料。
Once, a young noble dismissed Voracia as "just a lowly cook". She smiled sweetly at him, and his dish came with an "accidental" dose of an exceptionally bitter Mauler spice.
法蒂玛在处理一整条巨大的深海鱼时，砧板上连一丝划痕都没有留下。其实是因为那条鱼，被法蒂玛用肉眼看不见的细丝悬吊于砧板之上。
Voracia once butchered an enormous fish without leaving a single scratch on the chopping block. Her secret? The fish was actually suspended by threads invisible to the naked eye.
亲爱的，听说你也是一家餐馆的老板？做的一手好菜？
Dear, I heard you run a restaurant too? And that you're quite the cook!
